title: Dynamics 365 Business Central agent capabilities: how much does they cost me?
summary: The post explains how the new Sales Order Agent in Business Central 2025 Wave 1 automates email-based sales quote processing and details the billing models for agentic AI features. It covers Copilot Studio message-based pricing (pay-as-you-go at $0.01 per message or prepaid message packs at $200/month for 25,000 messages), environment linking requirements, and cost scenarios ranging from $77 to $803 monthly based on agent complexity and usage.
key_points: Sales Order Agent automatically processes customer email requests, clarifies details through multi-turn conversations, and generates formatted PDF quotes with pricing and availability information
Business Central must be linked to a Power Platform environment to enable agent billing and inherit Copilot Studio settings
Two billing models available: prepaid capacity (message packs at $200/month for 25,000 messages) or pay-as-you-go ($0.01 per message), both can run simultaneously with prepaid consumed first
Agent message consumption varies by task complexity, with costs depending on generative answers, autonomous actions, tenant graph grounding, and agent flow actions
ROI justification is essential, as agents can reduce manual workload and improve customer satisfaction but require cost-benefit analysis for sustainability

quotes.text: Business Central supports two billing models: prepaid capacity and pay-as-you-go.
quotes.why_it_matters: Essential for understanding the pricing options available and how to budget for agent functionality
